input.command:
cd /app && cat > solve.py <<'EOF'
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pgmpy.models import LinearGaussianBayesianNetwork as LG

d = pd.read_csv('bn_sample_10k.csv')

# Recovered DAG (to=child, from=parent). U has no parents.
edges = [('Y','U'),('R','U'),('D','U'),('M','U'),('D','Y'),('M','R')]
pd.DataFrame(edges, columns=['to','from']).to_csv('learned_dag.csv', index=False)

model = LG([(f, t) for (t, f) in edges])  # add_edge expects (parent,child)
model.fit(d)
assert model.check_model()

# Intervention on Y (do Y=0.0)
interv = model.do('Y', inplace=False)
pd.DataFrame([(c, p) for (p, c) in interv.edges()], columns=['to','from']).to_csv('intervened_dag.csv', index=False)

samp = model.simulate(n_samples=10000, do={'Y': 0.0}, seed=0)
samp = samp[list(d.columns)]
samp.to_csv('final_bn_sample.csv', index=False)

print('learned edges:', edges)
print('intervened edges:', list(interv.edges()))
print('sample Y mean/var:', samp['Y'].mean(), samp['Y'].var())
print(samp.describe())
EOF
python3 solve.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warning
cd /app && for f in learned_dag.csv intervened_dag.csv final_bn_sample.csv; do echo "== $f =="; head -3 $f; wc -l $f; done
